messages.text: Which events table should feed insight.product.events: trackEvents or trackEvents_v1?
Use trackEvents. trackEvents_v1 is deprecated and frozen since the 2024 tracker rebuild; do not use it except for a one-off backfill of pre-2024 history.
Careful: evtTs in trackEvents_v1 is Pacific time, while trackEvents is UTC.
For tickets, satisfaction_score should come from csatScore. It is 1-5 in the help desk; keep the same scale.
Where do NPS survey answers live? The nps_responses table needs a source.
NPS was collected in an external survey tool that we never synced, so there is no source for nps_responses in the warehouse. It starts fresh.
accounts.industry: we never captured industry on acctMaster. Sales enrichment will populate it later, so it has no source today.
